reasonPlaceholder: e.g. WeChat payment received / user requested a refund
reasonHint: This reason is written to the audit log and is required.

login.title: Admin sign in
login.subtitle: This console is fully isolated from the end-user account system. Administrator accounts only.
login.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
login.configMissing: The console signing key (ADMIN_SESSION_SECRET) is not configured. Contact your deployer.
login.genericFailed: Sign-in failed. Please try again later.
login.notAuthorized: This account has no admin access.

dashboard.description: Platform overview based on subscriptions and accounts. Model calls are never billed here.
dashboard.revenueNote: Revenue sums paid orders that have not been refunded.

users.description: Look up accounts, inspect membership, ban accounts, or adjust membership manually.
users.emptyDescription: Try another keyword, or clear the filters.
users.banDescription: A banned account cannot sign in, and existing sessions stop working on their next check.
users.unbanDescription: The account can sign in again.
users.detailNoOrders: This account has no orders yet
users.adjustNoActiveHint: This account has no active membership, so only "grant by plan" is available.

orders.description: Inspect subscription orders, issue refunds, and repair missed activations. Refunds cancel the subscription; repairs never activate twice.
orders.searchPlaceholder: Search order number or user email
orders.emptyDescription: Try another keyword, or clear the filters.
orders.refundDescription: The subscription is cancelled immediately and access is revoked. This cannot be undone.
orders.repairDescription: For orders already paid at the gateway but not activated here. Already-activated orders are never activated twice.

plans.description: Maintain sellable plans: price, duration, and whether other providers are unlocked. Deactivating is a soft delete and does not affect existing subscriptions.
plans.emptyDescription: Run npm run db:seed to create the default plans, or add one here.
plans.fieldLevel: Level (0 = free, higher means more permissions)
plans.fieldAllowAll: Allow providers other than the default one
plans.deactivateDescription: The plan disappears from the purchase list. Existing subscriptions are unaffected.

providers.description: Maintain platform-level model providers. The default provider is the only one free accounts can use, and there can be exactly one.
providers.emptyDescription: Run npm run db:seed to create the default provider, or add one here.
providers.fieldCodeHint: Must match the provider key in the code catalog, e.g. token61 / bailian. Immutable after creation.
providers.fieldDefault: Make this the platform default (clears the previous default)
providers.fieldConfigHint: Display config (JSON, optional): console URLs only — never API keys or base URLs
providers.setDefaultDescription: The previous default is cleared automatically. Free accounts will then only be able to use this provider.
providers.toggleDescription: A disabled provider leaves the allowed set immediately for every account that had configured it.

configs.description: System-level configuration (super admin only). Values are JSON, take effect immediately, and are written to the audit log.
configs.emptyDescription: Nothing has been written yet. Add an entry below.
configs.fieldValueHint: Valid JSON: a string array such as ["manual"], or an object such as a boolean enabled flag

logs.description: Audit trail of administrator actions (super admin only), including before/after values and the reason.
logs.searchPlaceholder: Search target id (order number / user id)

account.title: Account
account.description: Change your own admin password. The current session is invalidated immediately, so you will need to sign in again.
account.passwordRules: At least 12 characters, must contain a letter, and must not be a repeated character.
account.mismatch: The two new passwords do not match.
account.successDesc: This session is no longer valid. Please sign in with the new password.
account.sameAsCurrent: The new password must differ from the current one.

admins.description: Maintain admin accounts and roles. At least one active super admin must remain, and you cannot disable yourself.
admins.emptyDescription: There should normally be at least the seeded admin. Check the database initialization.
admins.resetHint: All sessions for that account are invalidated immediately; it must sign in with the new password.
admins.fieldUsernameHint: 3-32 chars of letters, digits, dot, underscore or hyphen. Immutable after creation.
admins.roleHintSupport: Support: user and order lookup, repair
admins.roleHintOperation: Operations: support plus ban, membership adjust, refund, plans & providers, stats
admins.roleHintSuper: Super admin: everything, including config, audit log and admin management
admins.lastSuperWarning: This is the last active super admin and cannot be disabled or demoted.
admins.selfWarning: You cannot disable the account you are signed in with.

payments.description: Configure merchant parameters and enablement for each payment channel. Secret fields are encrypted at rest and only ever returned masked; every change is written to the audit log.
payments.reasonHint: Every save and enable/disable on this page records this reason.
payments.reasonRequired: Enter a reason before saving or toggling a channel.
payments.disableDescription: New orders will no longer use this channel. Orders already created but unpaid can still be completed.
payments.docsLink: Open the provider console to get credentials
payments.notImplementedHint: The integration code for this channel is not implemented yet: you can store the credentials now and simply enable it later without touching configuration again.
payments.missingParamsHint: Fill in the required fields before enabling.
payments.saveAnywayHint: You can store the credentials now and enable it once the integration lands.
payments.callbackUrlLabel: Callback URL (configure at the payee side)
payments.callbackUrlHint: The payee must HMAC-SHA256 the raw request body with this secret and send it in the x-payment-signature header.
payments.secretConfiguredHint: Configured. Leave blank to keep it; enter a new value to replace it.

manual.name: Manual activation (offline payment)
manual.description: The user places an order and sends the order number to an operator, who activates it. Default channel; needs no merchant credentials.

hmac-webhook.name: Generic signed callback
hmac-webhook.description: The user pays on your own checkout page; the payee POSTs a signed callback and the order activates automatically. Works as soon as the secret is configured — no code change or redeploy.

alipay.name: Alipay
alipay.description: Alipay web / face-to-face payment. Integration pending: store the credentials now and enable it later.

wechat.name: WeChat Pay
wechat.description: WeChat Pay Native / JSAPI. Integration pending: store the credentials now and enable it later.

stripe.name: Stripe
stripe.description: Stripe Checkout. Integration pending: store the credentials now and enable it later.
